sampling: Four marks in each far law and sign stratum and waiting round and sign stratum, and three in each horizon law and archived hearing stratum, drawn without replacement. All recorded hearings at the proposed lower round bound and beyond four sharings included, plus the otherwise unselected shortened changed runs under the proposed bound and four further unselected far marks with short follow-up. The ordinary sign swap uses all its archived horizon places for the next round. The alternate numeric tie choice uses up to three sampled cells per sharing distance with a member outside the archive, choosing the highest name outside the original three and following the branch up to the proposed earliest hearing round plus three.
